physicalNotes: Radius 1.14 +/- 0.08 Jupiter radii, temperature 936 +66/-63 K and mass 4.1 +1.2/-1.0 Jupiter masses: the Exo-REM fit with a surface-gravity prior to the JWST/MIRI and near-infrared photometry of Malin et al. (2024, arXiv:2408.16843), Table 8: 81,500.9 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. Their fits span 1.0 to 1.14 Jupiter radii and 800 to 1050 K. A model radius: the planet is unresolved. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
